paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the quantity of AI Scientist publications on arXiv, categorized by whether or not they include implementation details. The x-axis is labeled “Time,” has a linear scale, ranges from “Fall ‘24” to “Spring ‘25”, and is divided into three labeled intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Quantity” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick marks at intervals of 3. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents publications “Without Implementation” and begins at a quantity of 10 in “Fall ‘24”, increases to 14 in “Winter ‘24”, and reaches a quantity of 21 in “Spring ‘25”. An orange line, marked with square data points, represents publications “With Implementation” and begins at a quantity of 2 in “Fall ‘24”, increases to 7 in “Winter ‘24”, and reaches a quantity of 13 in “Spring ‘25”.
